title: Taxable Portion of a Commuted Value on Non-Qualified Income Annuities
content:
On a non-qualified Ashgrove Income Annuities contract, the taxable part of a commuted value — the commuted value carried on the latest approved commutation election — is measured against the investment still unrecovered:

- **Investment already recovered.** On a non-qualified contract whose investment in the contract is already recovered (nothing of it remains unrecovered), the whole commuted value is taxable.
- **Investment not yet recovered.** On a non-qualified contract whose investment is not yet recovered, the taxable part is the commuted value less the investment still unrecovered, never below zero.
- A contract that is not non-qualified (for example a traditional, SEP or Roth IRA) is outside both rules.

**Investment still unrecovered.** It is the investment in the contract less the tax-free amount already recovered, the latter being the purchase amount less the unreturned purchase amount, multiplied by the exclusion ratio, that product rounded to the cent.

### Cases (hypothetical non-qualified contracts, commuted value $68,872.97)

| Investment in the contract | Purchase amount | Unreturned purchase amount | Exclusion ratio | Already recovered | Still unrecovered | Taxable part |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $150,000.00 | $150,000.00 | $40,000.00 | 55% | $60,500.00 | $89,500.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) |
| $80,500.00 | $150,000.00 | $40,000.00 | 55% | $60,500.00 | $20,000.00 | $48,872.97 |
| $60,500.00 | $150,000.00 | $40,000.00 | 55% | $60,500.00 | $0.00 | $68,872.97 (whole value) |
